content.json:
## Operations
Requests, server errors, latency, throttling and availability over the last seven days, and pause changes over thirty.

content.title: Requests and server errors per hour
content.query:
requests
| summarize Requests = count(), ServerErrors = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) by bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Request latency (p50, p95)
content.query:
requests
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Throttled dependency calls (429)
content.query:
dependencies
| where resultCode == '429'
| summarize Throttled = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), target

content.title: Availability (%)
content.query:
availabilityResults
| summarize Availability = 100.0 * avg(toint(success)) by bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Investigation pause changes (actor as a pseudonymous id, reason length only)
content.query:
traces
| where tostring(customDimensions.EventId) == '3301'
| project timestamp, Paused = tobool(customDimensions.Paused), Actor = tostring(customDimensions.Actor), ReasonLength = toint(customDimensions.ReasonLength)
| order by timestamp desc

content.json:
## Quality
How investigations ended, what the screens blocked, and what was refused before an investigation started.

content.title: Investigations by outcome
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'paymentops.investigations'
| summarize Investigations = sum(valueSum) by Outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| order by Investigations desc

content.title: Screen blocks by kind and verdict
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'paymentops.screen.blocks'
| summarize Blocks = sum(valueSum) by Kind = tostring(customDimensions.kind), Verdict = tostring(customDimensions.verdict)

content.title: Refused before an investigation started, by reason
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'paymentops.investigations.rejected'
| summarize Refused = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), Reason = tostring(customDimensions.reason)

content.title: Tool calls by outcome (refused: a merchant the user never named)
content.query:
dependencies
| where name startswith 'tool.'
| summarize Calls = count() by Tool = substring(name, 5), Outcome = tostring(customDimensions['paymentops.tool.outcome'])

content.json:
## Cost
What investigations used, and their estimated cost at list prices where usage and prices were complete.

content.title: Model tokens per day
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'paymentops.model.tokens'
| summarize Tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), Series = strcat(tostring(customDimensions.deployment), ' ', tostring(customDimensions.direction))

content.title: Content Safety records and requests per day
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ('paymentops.content_safety.records', 'paymentops.http.requests')
| summarize Count = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), Series = strcat(name, ' ', tostring(customDimensions.service))

content.title: Estimated cost per investigation (average) and per day
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'paymentops.investigation.estimated_cost'
| summarize PerInvestigation = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), PerDay = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), Currency = tostring(customDimensions.currency)
